extraction.tier_rationale: Small two-stage set with no covariates, so it is absolute; weight is required only for per-kg dosing. Prospectively nearly unbiased (MDPE +1%, MDAPE 17%, n=11), but the external evidence is a single small group, so Tier C. PK-only: the effect-site value used by STANPUMP ('see t_peaks.xls') is unsourced and not curated. The derivation population and age range are not in the reprint (a human item).

Attribution split: Raemer reprints it as Scott, Ponganis & Stanski 1985; stanpumpR cites Scott & Stanski 1987 (J Pharmacol Exp Ther 240:159). HUMAN ITEM: confirm which paper first printed this set.

notes: The other half of the alfentanil divergence pair; prospectively the better-calibrated set. Its 2.2 L central volume against Maitre's 7.8 L is the structural driver of the difference.
